fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-06-13 at about 16:25, it was reported that the complainant paid Rs. 4,00,000 to a person who promised a job placement, but no appointment order was provided and calls went unanswered. Inban Balan submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000367. The complainant alleged that Saravanan Anand may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000282. Yuvaraj Selvam (9000000434) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Items referenced in the complaint: digital documents and a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly paid a fee for a job that was never provided.
fields.Keywords: job fraud, cheating, suspect, afternoon, main street, call detail, mobile number, digital document
